name: GetTableRangeFromExcelWorksheet
label: Get Table Range from Excel Worksheet
description: Retrieves the range address (e.g., 'A1:B10') of a specified table or pivot table in the provided Excel worksheet.

fields.name: WorksheetInstance
fields.label: Worksheet Instance
fields.description: The Excel Worksheet object containing the target table or pivot table.

fields.name: TableName
fields.label: Table Name
fields.description: The name of the table (ListObject) or pivot table to retrieve the range for.

fields.name: IsPivotTable
fields.label: Is Pivot Table
fields.description: If true, retrieves the range of a pivot table instead of a regular table.

fields.name: FirstColumnIndex
fields.label: First Column Index
fields.description: Returns the column index of the first cell in the table range.

fields.name: FirstRowIndex
fields.label: First Row Index
fields.description: Returns the row index of the first cell in the table range.

fields.name: LastColumnIndex
fields.label: Last Column Index
fields.description: Returns the column index of the last cell in the table range.

fields.name: LastRowIndex
fields.label: Last Row Index
fields.description: Returns the row index of the last cell in the table range.
